Contributions to percent change of a Fisher volume index

Source: R/fisher_contrib.R
fisher_contrib.Rd

Exact contributions of the components to the percent change, from the previous period (quarter, month or year) to the current one, of the Fisher volume index of their aggregate (equation (32) of the paragraph 8.89 of the IMF QNA Manual).

Usage

fisher_contrib(cp, pi, extra = NULL)

Arguments

cp

Current prices of all the components of the aggregate (ts or mts). The aggregate is their sum.

pi

Price indices of the components over the previous period (previous quarter, month or year = 100), with the same structure as cp. Price indices over the previous year can be converted with pi_py2pp().

extra

Additional columns: "total" adds the percent change of the Fisher volume index, and "residual" the difference between this percent change and the sum of the contributions (zero, up to numerical errors).

Value

A ts (or mts) of contributions, in percentage points, with the span and the columns of cp (followed by Total and/or Residual). The first period is NA.

Details

With \(x^t\) the current price value of the component \(x\) in period \(t\), \(z^t\) the one of the aggregate, \(r_j = p_j^t / p_j^{t-1}\) the price index of the component \(j\) over the previous period, and \(F\) the Fisher volume index of the aggregate (previous period = 1), the contribution of the component \(x\) is $$100 \frac{\frac{z^t}{z^{t-1}} \left(x^t / r_x - x^{t-1}\right) + F \left(x^t - x^{t-1} r_x\right)}{z^t + F \sum_j x_j^{t-1} r_j}.$$ Contributions add up exactly to the percent change of the Fisher index, whatever the number of components.

The formula as printed in the manual has the ratio \(z^{t-1} / z^t\) in the first term and \(x^{t-1} p_x^{t-1} / p_x^t\) in the second one. With these ratios the contributions do not add up to the percent change (checked numerically), so that the formula implemented corrects them (\(z^t / z^{t-1}\) and \(x^{t-1} p_x^t / p_x^{t-1}\), consistent with the denominator). Among the variants of the formula that were tested, it is the only one that is exact.

The adjustments that some countries add to the quarterly contributions (benchmarking of the quarterly Fisher indices on the annual ones, percent changes at annual rates) are not done. As recommended by the manual (paragraph 8.90), the contribution of a variable that can be negative, zero or positive (such as changes in inventories) should be calculated residually, as the difference between the contribution of the aggregate that includes it and the contributions of the other components.

References

Chevalier, M. (2003), "Chain Fisher Volume Index Methodology", Statistics Canada (formula drawn from the appendix II).

International Monetary Fund (2018), Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), chapter 8 "Price and Volume Measures", Washington, DC. doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .

See also

fisher(), chain_contrib()

Examples

# Price indices over the previous quarter (example 8.4)
ep <- pi_py2pp(imf_pi)
fisher_contrib(imf_cp, ep, extra = c("total", "residual"))
